subject: api_contracts
summary: OpenAPI adequately elevates W4 authorized release at standard density: POST /reservations/{holdId}/release 204 is a first-class success channel that documents restore of held quantity to available stock (and hold removal) as client/test MUST semantics; W3 403 UnauthorizedError no-mutation and 400 PreconditionError channels are preserved; W1/W2 reserve 200 and InsufficientStockError surfaces are not thinned; TTL expiry is explicitly deferred to later changes. solidsdd-lint is pass (minors only).

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text (unchanged by API apply)
lint: overlapping touches on shared OpenAPI/OCL/src across W4–W5; solidsdd-run must serialize these items

Reusable InsufficientStockError and UnauthorizedError response components are defined but unused; operations document channels inline. Polish only—named errorType enum and examples already make failures distinguishable.

Authorized restore is stated in 204 description prose (stock increase by prior hold quantity; holdId no longer active) without a response body returning availableStock. Adequate at standard density—checkable MUST semantics plus OCL posts own the restore property; stronger HTTP observation would be polish only.
